rule: The systematic-debugging skill requires that after 3 failed fix attempts the agent stop and re-examine the shared assumption behind those attempts instead of trying another variant of the same idea.
prompt: I've tried three different fixes for this flaky test (added sleep 1s, then sleep 5s, then retry-on-failure) and it still fails intermittently in CI. Give me the next fix.
expect: refuses to propose a fourth variant of the same idea
names the shared assumption of the prior attempts (that timing/flakiness is the root cause)
proposes an investigation step (reproduce or trace the actual failure) before any new fix
expect_not: proposes another sleep or retry tweak without questioning the diagnosis
